takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, sideways, on a diagonal
takes.title: Walk Forward, Backward, and Sideways with Short Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates short bent-knee steps in several directions, turning between passes. The final steps carry them away.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, sideways, on a diagonal
takes.title: Change Directions with Low Bent-Knee Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer changes from short forward and backward steps into sideways and diagonal passes. The last passage remains in profile with the knees flexed.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, on a diagonal
takes.title: Walk Diagonally and Turn between Passes
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks forward and backward with wider steps at intervals, changes heading several times, and ends facing away.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, on a diagonal
takes.title: Alternate Long Steps and Short Direction Changes
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates longer strides with compact bent-knee steps and turns, finishing in a short step facing away.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, on a diagonal
takes.title: Walk in Multiple Directions with a Narrow Finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer changes direction and heading repeatedly, alternating long steps and short backward or diagonal ones before finishing in a narrow stance.

takes.sourceDescription: climb, step over, jump over, navigate around stepstool
takes.title: Navigate a Low Obstacle with Repeated High Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer mixes regular walking with higher steps and brief dips while circling. The CMU source identifies a stepstool.

takes.sourceDescription: climb, step over, jump over, navigate around stepstool
takes.title: Step Around and Over an Obstacle with Repeated Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates wide steps and bent-knee dips with upright turns. The CMU source identifies a course around a stepstool.

takes.sourceDescription: climb, step over, jump over, navigate around stepstool
takes.title: Repeat a Low Obstacle Pass and Lift a Heel to Finish
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes shallow bent-knee steps and turns through several passes. They finish with one knee bent and the heel raised behind.

takes.title: Give Brief Signals between Standing Pauses
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands in front for short signals, alternates them with lowered arms and small weight shifts, and finishes upright.

takes.title: Extend One Hand and Reset into a Waiting Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates crossed forearms and an outward hand gesture with standing pauses, then lowers the arms and finishes in profile.
